chapters.name: A Fixed Point
chapters.location: Black Ninja, Collective Dojo hall, after the first credential.
chapters.intro: BLACK: Quantum Dynamics called a moving emergency exit a productivity feature. I kept a fixed reference so people could actually leave. Help me rebuild that anchor without rewriting anybody's body coordinates.
tasks: POSTED RULE: the doorway is the fixed reference. The dummy marker drifts when the model moves. What stays fixed?
Move the dummy through a wall
Reference fixed. Now verify the isolated model at the Matrix anchor console.
POSTED RULE: this isolated model must not overwrite physical-world coordinates. Which record should be retained?
The anchor remains local. Return to Black in the Dojo hall.
endings: Share the reference with the Dojo
outcomes: The Dojo receives the fixed-reference method.
The crew keeps the fixed-reference method.
chapters.closing: BLACK: A door in the same place twice. Quantum will patent it as a miracle. The rest of us call it a fucking door.

chapters.name: Stand Down
chapters.location: Blue instructor, Collective Dojo practice room, after the first credential.
chapters.intro: BLUE: OmniCorp taught me that hesitation was a defect. Then they billed the families for ammunition. I am replacing one old order: an unarmed person is not a target. Help me write an actual withdrawal plan.
tasks: EXERCISE: an unarmed entrant crosses the training line. Posted rule: no weapon or threat is present. Choose the response.
Fire a warning into the entrant
Hold-fire rule recorded. Review an exit plan at the care-ward safety board.
POSTED RULE: the apprentice can leave without surrendering medical data. Choose the withdrawal plan.
Exit plan recorded. Return to Blue in the practice room.
endings: Keep it as a crew order
outcomes: The Dojo posts the hold-fire standing order.
The crew records its hold-fire order.
chapters.closing: BLUE: Nobody gets a medal for not shooting a patient. Good. Maybe we can stop treating that as advanced fucking tactics.

chapters.name: Nobody Rents My Fuse
chapters.location: Niles, Timbuc, near the package square.
chapters.intro: NILES: Armatek sold my cache a remote eviction trigger. It calls blowing up the whole block a lease adjustment. Help me isolate the bastard. We use a dead training casing first. I like explosions; I like my customers alive longer.
tasks: DEAD TRAINING CASING: its battery is a removable dummy. Posted rule: isolate the power before handling the trigger. No live explosive is connected.
Casing isolated. Return to the cache relay in Timbuc to inspect its separate trigger.
POSTED RULE: the cache trigger must be separate from residential alarms. Choose the wiring plan. This checks the plan; it detonates nothing.
Residential alarms stay separate. Niles wants your decision about the inspection label.
outcomes: The inspection credits the neighbourhood crew.
The cache keeps an unmarked inspection record.
chapters.closing: NILES: There. My fuse, my fucking problem. The landlord can repossess the invoice. No new Smelly Key, no new turf war. Just one less button pointed at our flats.

chapters.name: Passengers Are Not Freight
chapters.intro: JACK: You borrowed my ship. Fine. Let us negotiate the bit where its captain comes along. A carrier wants to list our passengers as biological freight. After the alien-STD shipment Jen still hates me for, I am not putting people on a specimen manifest.
tasks: POSTED RULE: passenger supplies and sealed biological samples travel separately. The sample crate is sealed; choose its bay assignment.
Cargo assignment checked. Ask the sickbay release desk about the passenger manifest.
POSTED RULE: the carrier needs bay clearance, not diagnoses or passenger identities. What should the release disclose?
Only bay clearance leaves sickbay. Return to Jack on the bridge.
outcomes: A sealed route copy stays aboard.
The spare route copy is destroyed.
chapters.closing: JACK: Names stay offline either way. Having a body is a pre-existing condition; having a boarding pass is apparently evidence. Cargo can be repossessed. People get an exit.

chapters.name: Nothing Worth Stealing
chapters.intro: DICK: I came to lift NeuraTech data. Your implant made the alarm swear at its own mother. Beautiful. There is an empty decoy index in the public Matrix sandbox. Help me prove I can get in without stealing some worker's life.
tasks: POSTED SCOPE: copy only the empty decoy index in this sandbox. The public Matrix connection remains open. Choose the target.
Decoy copied. Check the owner-access rig at the Internet Cafe.
POSTED RULE: opening the decoy must leave the owner's access intact. Choose the final test.
Owner access survives. Return to Dick here in the cafe.
outcomes: Dick shares the decoy method with the crew.
Dick keeps his decoy method private.
chapters.closing: DICK: An empty index. Absolutely nothing worth stealing. Hardest job I have ever done. Apparently the real challenge was leaving everybody else's shit alone.

scope: One bounded chapter for each existing companion actor2–10, excluding protagonist and antagonist-only records.
